item.title: NHSDG Estates & Property Grounds Maintenance
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-17T12:00:00Z
The contract to be tendered by NHS Dumfries & Galloway (the “Authority) is for the direct provision of the estate wide grounds maintenance services. The works will be to the Estates open spaces, pathways, common grounds, shrub beds and wooded areas, mainly located within the boundaries of the Estates properties.
